errors.text: The proposal explicitly excludes incoherent C14 Laves phases, whereas the target mechanism relies on coexistence of the fcc matrix with a C14 Laves phase.
Formation of the proposed Al-rich L12 precipitates requires adding Al, substantially changing the nominal FeCoNiTi material system.

The cited evidence establishes precipitate formation or low coercivity in compositionally different alloys but does not support restoration of orbital moment, enhanced spin-orbit coupling, or coercivity above 100 Oe in Fe-Co-Ni-Ti.

The experiment does not isolate phase-specific magnetic transitions or compare against a compositionally matched C14-dominant phase, so it cannot decisively assign elevated-temperature magnetism to the fcc versus secondary phase.
